predecessors.name: Sui dynasty
predecessors.text: Liuhe, 'in modern Nanjing, Jiangsu', where Du had settled by fall 616

successors.name: Tang dynasty
successors.text: the infobox territory: 'Land south of the Huai River, roughly modern central and southern Jiangsu, Anhui, and parts of Zhejiang', drawn as a 130 km disc round Nanjing (Danyang, the later headquarters)

ledger.x: Fall 616: Du Fuwei settles at Liuhe.
Summer 620: Du Fuwei becomes the Tang's Prince of Wu.

wars.name: Du Fuwei against Chen Leng
wars.outcome: 'in spring 617, Du intentionally enraged Chen by sending Chen women clothes'; 'In fall 619, Li was sieging Chen at Jiangling, and Chen sought help from both Shen and Du'; Du submitted to Tang around 619-620.

certainty.note: A rebel warlord's land south of the Huai with no boundary; the infobox gives modern provinces only.
